scope.description: Review-first enrichment of nine named production records using exact live baselines and durable public evidence.

source.title: Sentinel Advanced Military Solutions
source.locator: Who We Are and Backed by CMP sections
source.summary: Sentinel identifies its CMP Group operating context and CMP Advanced Mechanical Solutions manufacturing backing.

followUpQuestions: Can legal ownership and intercompany workshare be resolved from an authoritative public record?
reviewWarnings: Official source does not quantify ownership, workshare, production capacity, certifications, customers, or deployments.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: Recovered a material parent/manufacturing relationship absent from the published profile.
Confirmed the five existing capability families are already represented and should not be duplicated.
No authoritative legal ownership or independent deployment record was recovered.

leads.refreshSummary: Add CMP Advanced Mechanical Solutions as bounded manufacturing and systems-integration backing for Sentinel.
intendedChanges: Add one public relationship without changing the already-current capability portfolio.

source.title: YMX Innovation Centre
source.summary: ADM now describes seven YMX platforms and concrete operating characteristics for experimental and pre-commercial testing.

leads.evidenceLocator: ADM seven-platform model and DND NEXUS operating context
followUpQuestions: What access, booking, accreditation, capacity, and equipment constraints apply to each platform?
reviewWarnings: Facility scope does not establish access, eligibility, accreditation, capacity, or DND endorsement.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: Recovered the current seven-platform model and concrete facility characteristics.
Checked French-language YMX positioning and retained English detail as the richer current source.
Confirmed that NEXUS operates primarily at YMX while remaining a distinct program.

leads.refreshSummary: Update YMX profile data with its current seven-platform testbed model and operating characteristics.
intendedChanges: Replace older four-sector profile data with seven current platforms and bounded operating-environment details.

source.title: Archer Tactical Troposcatter Datasheet
source.summary: The current datasheet confirms the already-published range, setup, security, and adaptive-performance claims but exposes no additional machine-readable values.

leads.evidenceLocator: Official portfolio, datasheet, and live capability comparison
followUpQuestions: Will Marconi publish numeric frequency, bandwidth, throughput, latency, power, environmental, or interface values?
reviewWarnings: Another candidate would duplicate the August 4 reviewed record and existing FMV evaluation.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: Confirmed the current public datasheet contains headings but no recoverable additional numeric values.
Confirmed the published capability already mirrors the official product detail.
No material new evaluation, contract, configuration, or specification was found beyond current publication.

leads.refreshSummary: No non-duplicative Archer change is supported by the current public evidence.
intendedChanges: Defer until a material specification, evaluation, contract, or configuration change appears.

source.title: PacifiCan invests in defence innovation in AI and aerospace
source.summary: PacifiCan identifies CAD 3.015 million for a next-generation satellite demonstrator for in-orbit operations, already captured in the live record.

leads.evidenceLocator: PacifiCan project row and grants record
followUpQuestions: What spacecraft architecture, payload, orbit, interfaces, maturity, partner, milestone, and demonstration date are public?
reviewWarnings: Only the award amount and broad satellite-demonstrator purpose are public and both are already represented.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: No additional durable technical specification or milestone was recovered.
Confirmed the live record already contains the full public project description and amount.
Recovered agreement lifecycle context but no decision-useful technical detail.

leads.refreshSummary: Defer Arcane until a public technical milestone supports more than the already-published RDII project description.
intendedChanges: No operation until durable technical or program evidence becomes available.

source.title: ChimeraXR immersive training systems
source.locator: Project Spear and Project Mythos product sections
source.summary: The official material confirms Project Spear and Mythos details already represented in the live capability records.

leads.evidenceLocator: Official product pages, ISC listing, and NRC contribution
followUpQuestions: Has a new version, independent trial, contract, deployment, or durable technical document been published?
reviewWarnings: Additional technical detail found in a personal portfolio is not suitable as a canonical evidence anchor.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: Confirmed both published capabilities already contain the material official product detail.
Confirmed the Project Spear program context is already represented.
Confirmed the IRAP scenario-builder context is already represented.

leads.refreshSummary: No non-duplicative ChimeraXR operation is supported by the reviewed durable sources.
intendedChanges: Defer until a new product, trial, contract, deployment, or technical publication appears.

source.title: Canadian Technology Systems Disrupters
source.locator: Lance, TwinLance, robot compatibility, projectiles, and features
source.summary: CTS publishes detailed Lance and TwinLance system architecture and EOD deployment characteristics absent from the generic live capability.

leads.evidenceLocator: English and French official product pages plus CED RDII corroboration
followUpQuestions: What independent trials, environmental qualifications, customer use, quantities, and current deployments are public?
reviewWarnings: Restricted specifications, independent performance evidence, customers, quantities, and deployments remain unknown.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: Recovered named systems, architecture, firing options, projectiles, robot compatibility, aiming, recoil, and deployment packaging.
Corroborated the same technical structure in French.
Confirmed current public program activity tied to explosive-device-neutralization equipment.

leads.refreshSummary: Update the existing generic capability to the named Lance and TwinLance EOD system family with public technical detail.
intendedChanges: Update the existing capability in place; do not create a duplicate product family.

source.title: Enzyme-converted O kidneys in a human decedent model
source.summary: Peer-reviewed evidence establishes a preclinical transplant milestone and material antigen-regeneration limits absent from the current broad capability.

leads.evidenceLocator: Peer-reviewed enzyme, perfusion, antigen-removal, transplant, and limitation evidence
followUpQuestions: What regulatory, clinical, manufacturing, shelf-life, field-workflow, safety, and NATO DIANA milestones are public?
reviewWarnings: The milestone is preclinical and antigen regeneration remains a material limitation.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: Recovered enzyme identity, perfusion modes, and measured antigen-removal evidence.
Recovered the human-decedent transplant milestone and antigen-regeneration constraint.
Confirmed Avivo's link to the research and its current DIANA and process-development context.

leads.refreshSummary: Update Avivo's capability with measured preclinical results and the material antigen-regeneration limitation.
intendedChanges: Refine the existing capability in place and label maturity as preclinical.

source.title: CompleteWaters USV Services
source.locator: Autopilot, sonar, positioning, exports, and applications
source.summary: The official USV service describes a distinct autonomous surface-vessel capability absent from the current ROV-only portfolio.

leads.evidenceLocator: Official USV service and Canada-wide operating profile
followUpQuestions: What endurance, sea-state, communications, autonomy assurance, accuracy, and Arctic trial details are public?
reviewWarnings: The published service is civil and inland-focused; Arctic and defence performance remain unproven.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: Recovered a distinct surface-vessel sonar and payload capability with public frequencies, positioning, and export formats.
Confirmed Canada-wide ROV, USV, monitoring, boat, certification, and bounded Arctic experience.
Confirmed adjacent water-quality sensing but kept this run focused on the omitted USV capability.

leads.refreshSummary: Add a distinct portable autonomous USV sonar and payload service beside the existing ROV capability.
intendedChanges: Add one capability with empty mission matches and bounded civil operating context.

source.title: XMA-11K Brochure
source.summary: The current official brochure provides power, life, RF, channel, interface, and physical detail absent from the sparse live capability.

leads.evidenceLocator: Official XMA specification, technology page, and NRC OceanWave award
followUpQuestions: What surfacing trigger, service dependency, release integration, qualification, OceanWave specification, and current deployment evidence are public?
reviewWarnings: XMA-11K is a recovery beacon, not a surveillance sensor; OceanWave remains development context only.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: Recovered detailed electrical, RF, programming, endurance, battery, and physical specifications.
Recovered pressure-test, housing, GNSS, low-power, and sealing context.
Recovered current OceanWave development activity but no public product specification.

leads.refreshSummary: Deepen the XMA-11K capability and add bounded OceanWave development activity without creating a premature new product.
intendedChanges: Update the existing XMA capability and organization profile_data in place.
